inputs: fine-tuned DINOv3 epoch_018 (hash-checked, FP32): CLS token and attention-pooled patch embedding, the two vectors its own head already uses; one forward pass, no extra model
head: StandardScaler + logistic regression (C = 0.05, balanced classes)

trained_on.real: 5,000 Label_0 training photos + 900 benchmark_v1-v3 eBay photos
trained_on.generated: Kandinsky 2.2: benchmark_v1-v3 (852) + kandinsky22_train (534, scenes T1-T8); SDXL (150), aMUSEd (293), Stable Cascade lite (296) from benchmark_v1-v3

thresholds.source: real photos only: 1,000 Label_0 validation + 900 eBay (out-of-fold); at most 1% FAKE and at most 5% more REVIEW

decision: FAKE if score >= t_fake; REVIEW if score >= t_review or DINOv3 REVIEW; else AUTHENTIC (score = head decision function)

development_results.scene_holdout: trained on T1-T4 scenes: 100% of T5-T8 Kandinsky caught; trained on T5-T8: 97.9-100% of T1-T4
